text:
The perimeter of one equilateral triangle is 21 inches, so each side of the triangle is 21 ÷ 3 = 7 inches. In a regular hexagon divided into six equilateral triangles, the side length of each triangle is equal to the side length of the hexagon. Therefore, the hexagon has a side length of 7 inches and 6 sides, giving a perimeter of 6 × 7 = 42 inches.

Answer: 42
